### American Integrity Insurance Group, Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Date and Conference Call


October 27, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/412004638/files/doc_news/2026/10/27/American-Integrity-Insurance-Group-Inc-Announces-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Release-Date-and-Conference-Call.pdf)


TAMPA, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


American Integrity Insurance Group, Inc. (NYSE: AII) (“American Integrity” or the “Company”), a Tampa-based property and casualty insurance holding company, today announced that it will release its third quarter 2026 results after the market close on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, and will host a conference call at 9:30 a.m. ET the following day, Wednesday, November 11, 2026.


To participate in the call, register at[https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/544753936?pwd=05mgzbqL](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fanalyst%2F544753936%3Fpwd%3D05mgzbqL&esheet=54629376&newsitemid=20261026086610&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fanalyst%2F544753936%3Fpwd%3D05mgzbqL&index=1&md5=cc87102d2ed1df97b939e56ba45674f3) or dial +1 833 461 5787 (U.S. Toll-Free) or +1 585 542 9983 for International (Toll), using Meeting ID: 544753936. A unique dial-in code will be provided upon registration. The conference call will also be webcast live on the Company’s investor relations website at[https://investor.aii.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.aii.com&esheet=54629376&newsitemid=20261026086610&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.aii.com&index=2&md5=4b914ad8fe381a2c25eafffc63e9073c) .


A replay of the call will be available approximately two hours after the live call concludes and will remain accessible for one year at[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/544753936](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F544753936&esheet=54629376&newsitemid=20261026086610&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F544753936&index=3&md5=4ee3de8eee16d4fa62305fcc15e57a0e) and on the Company’s investor relations website.


**About American Integrity Insurance Group** American Integrity Insurance Group, Inc. (NYSE: AII) is a leading provider of residential property insurance in Florida, focused on delivering innovative, reliable coverage to homeowners throughout the Southeast. Built on a foundation of integrity, resilience, and service, the Company’s mission is to be the most trusted and responsive insurance solution in the markets it serves. Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Tampa, American Integrity is committed to protecting policyholders with strength and purpose–today and for generations to come. For more information, visit[www.aii.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.aii.com&esheet=54629376&newsitemid=20261026086610&lan=en-US&anchor=www.aii.com&index=4&md5=5c6ab38cc0b041670a78f64c6a3f3b1c) .
